mostWorthwhile.text: Following insulin to the muscle was worthwhile because it showed that glucose becomes stored material while insulin remains a message outside the cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Releasing glucagon felt less engaging as a separate step: its destination and purpose were already labelled, and it was the only gameplay action offered.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the insulin message to stay outside the muscle cells while glucose went in and became stored carbohydrate.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though I followed the named hormone pairings rather than understanding exactly how the messages cause cells to respond.

continue.text: I might continue if another chapter connects the body systems in a similarly clear way, though the mostly guided pairings made the choices less engaging.
